issues.description: Script uses GM_xmlhttpRequest to access SponsorBlock API and multiple Cobalt instances for video download. These are third-party servers and may receive YouTube video IDs and possibly other metadata.
issues.recommendation: Review transmitted data, ensure only non-sensitive info is sent. Warn users about potential privacy implications.

issues.recommendation: Ensure only non-sensitive preferences are stored. Do not expand to sensitive data collection.

issues.description: Script applies playbackRate tricks and DOM manipulation but does not use eval, new Function, setTimeout(string), setInterval(string), or dynamic script injection.
issues.recommendation: Maintain avoidance of dynamic code execution.

issues.description: No evidence of code obfuscation, base64 decoding, unicode string encoding, or minified/obfuscated code.
issues.recommendation: Continue to publish readable, auditable code.

script_name: EasyTube V3 — Ad Skip, SponsorBlock & HD Download⬇️🚀
summary: The script transmits YouTube video IDs and possibly other metadata to third-party servers (SponsorBlock and Cobalt instances) for ad skipping and video downloading. No evidence of sensitive data collection or code obfuscation. Supply chain risk exists due to reliance on unofficial Cobalt APIs. Overall, the script is readable and avoids dynamic code execution, but users should be aware of privacy and supply chain risks.
